# American Airlines and STARLUX Airlines launch codeshare partnership to expand trans-Pacific flight options


[(English) (opens in new window) PDF 93 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/986123435/files/doc_news/American-Airlines-and-STARLUX-Airlines-launch-codeshare-partnership-to-expand-trans-Pacific-flight-options-NET-ALP-09-2026.pdf)


- American Airlines and STARLUX Airlines have launched a new codeshare partnership connecting North America with Taipei (TPE).
- Select flights are available to book today for travel starting Sept. 30.
- AAdvantage® members purchasing a codeshare flight under the partnership can earn miles and Loyalty Points.


FORT WORTH, Texas — American Airlines and STARLUX Airlines have launched a new codeshare partnership to enhance flight options between North America and Taipei. Under the partnership, travelers can book select STARLUX-operated flights between the Western U.S. and Taipei.


“Taipei remains a top destination for global business, visiting friends and family and leisure travel, and together with STARLUX Airlines, we’re partnering to provide new travel options,” said American’s Senior Vice President of Alliances Anmol Bhargava. “This collaboration strengthens our global network and unlocks new competitive itineraries. We look forward to working with STARLUX on opportunities to make the journey even more rewarding for customers.”


AAdvantage® members can earn miles and Loyalty Points when booking an American codeshare flight operated by STARLUX. American and STARLUX will work together on future opportunities including mileage redemption and additional travel benefits.


“This codeshare marks an important milestone for STARLUX,” said STARLUX Airlines CEO Glenn Chai. “American Airlines is an ideal partner, with a network across North America that complements what we’ve built across Asia. Together, we can provide our passengers with a more seamless and convenient travel experience between two of the world’s most dynamic regions.”


### Growing trans-Pacific access


Taipei is one of Asia’s must-visit cities. Famous for night markets that are a foodie’s paradise, old-world charm with museums and temples and the buzz of a cosmopolitan, modern city, Taipei captivates with experiences for every kind of traveler. In addition, this partnership will also support growing trans-Pacific business ties for major industries such as semiconductors.


American will place its code on STARLUX-operated flights to Taipei Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Ontario International Airport (ONT), San Francisco International Airport (SFO) and Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA).


American will also place its code on STARLUX-operated flights between Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) and TPE pending regulatory approvals.


The journey is just as important as the destination. As American continues to elevate the travel experience with new onboard products and amenities designed around customer comfort, it is also partnering with airlines that offer unique and premium experiences. STARLUX Airlines offers customers a unique experience that introduces travelers to the lively spirit and friendly hospitality of Taipei from the moment they board the aircraft.


Under this partnership, customers will be able to tailor their itinerary with Business Class, Premium Economy and Economy Class options on STARLUX available for purchase on aa.com or American’s mobile app. STARLUX offers customer-friendly amenities on board including lie-flat seats featuring a privacy door in Business Class and a leg rest and retractable footrest in Premium Economy, similar to American’s offerings on its new Boeing 787-9 and retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER aircraft.


**About American Airlines Group (NASDAQ: AAL)**
American Airlines is a premium global airline connecting more of the U.S. to the world. With roots tracing back to an air mail carrier in the Midwestern United States in 1926, American now operates more than 6,000 daily flights to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries and serves more than 200 million customers annually. Powered by a proud and talented team of 130,000 aviation professionals, American’s team lives out the airline’s purpose of caring for people on life’s journey every day.


The world’s largest airline proudly celebrates its centennial year in 2026, reaching a milestone that reflects a century of innovation and the Forever Forward℠ spirit that changed the industry and the world. American introduced the first scheduled air cargo service, the first airport lounge and the first airline loyalty program and continues to reinvent the customer experience today. The airline is also a founding member of the **one** world alliance, whose members serve more than 900 destinations around the globe.


Get the latest about American at[news.aa.com](https://news.aa.com/) and[@AmericanAir](https://x.com/AmericanAir) .


**About STARLUX Airlines**
Founded on the philosophy that luxury should be available to everyone, not just the elite, Taiwan-based STARLUX is a boutique international airline serving a total of 34 destinations across Europe, the US, Japan, South Korea, Macau, Hong Kong, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. STARLUX passengers traveling between Europe and Asia are able to enjoy an easy transfer in Taipei. Recognized globally for its excellence, STARLUX has been awarded Skytrax 5-Star Airline status, earned the APEX Five-Star Global Airline Awards, and received a 7-Star PLUS Safety Rating from AirlineRatings. STARLUX prioritizes safety and offers unparalleled service with the goal of making flying a truly luxurious and unforgettable experience. For more information visit[www.starlux-airlines.com](http://www.starlux-airlines.com/)
